page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.12xlarge is an arm64-based memory-optimized instance running on the AWS Nitro System. It is powered by dedicated AWS Graviton processors clocked at 3.3 GHz, delivering 48 physical cores across 48 vCPUs with a single-thread-per-core architecture that avoids hyper-threading contention. The hardware allocation provides 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

Storage and I/O infrastructure includes 2850 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD instance storage, enabling high-speed ephemeral scratch space and low-latency disk operations. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an efficiency perspective, the dedicated Graviton cores provide predictable compute performance and dense memory capacity for arm64-native environments. The primary tradeoff lies in software architecture compatibility, requiring arm64 binaries. The instance profile is designed for data-heavy workloads, including in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, real-time analytics, and transactional database systems.
